block.title: Citadel full-dimension sweep
block.positive: SNES-era 16-bit pixel art inspired concept rendering, bold dark outlines, saturated limited palette, ultra-wide side-scrolling arcade composition, subtle CRT scanline glow. An ultrawide cross-section of an Iron Citadel hall, the whole depth of the fortress on one band: at the far right a second SENTINEL WALKER steps through a gateway of overlapping armored doors, red eye already locked left; across the ceiling a dense forest of pipes and hanging cable chains, amber running lights dotted along a maintenance rail in receding perspective; along the deck a full network of open trenches runs parallel to the scroll, and in three of them TRENCH EELS are visible in different states — one deep and only a glow-line under the plate, one mid-rise with snout and first coils clear of the deck, one at full arc spitting a cluster of violet ring-sparks; a Gyre-like shadow of rotating ring-gun silhouettes guards the hall's far end. In the left foreground the MANTA sails through the gauntlet, its pale mint ray-wing hull washed orange by the amber lamps along every plate edge, green canopy low, amber twin thrusters steady, trailing two gold shield-glint ellipses behind it like discarded rings. A sentry cannon flash kicks off a girder above the manta's left wingtip. Deep-navy in the hall's ceiling void, never pure black. No text, no UI elements.

block.notes: Color reference: eel glow-line #b84cff under #0c1a3c plate shadow, lamps #e8a030 on rails, manta mint #c8e0d0 going peach under amber. The three-state eel row (hidden / rising / firing) doubles as a visual tutorial for the mechanic — keep the left-to-right order, it's the zone's reading order. Vertical slice layout makes this the strongest of the three for a website band.
